chunks: But God will turn the joke against them and allow them to sink deeper into evil and wander perplexed in their wickedness.

key_terms.يَسْتَهْزِئُ: He mocks or turns the joke against

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God 'extends' the hypocrites in their tyranny?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine retribution of 'Istihza' (mockery) where God allows hypocrites to remain entrenched in their self-deception until the truth becomes undeniable. The phrase 'ya'mahoon' (wander blindly) reflects their spiritual disorientation, a state emphasized by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as a consequence of their deliberate rejection of clear signs.
